disease.name: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC)
disease.full_name: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma — the dominant pancreatic malignancy (~90% of pancreatic cancers); arises from pancreatic exocrine duct epithelium
disease.global_burden: Among the most lethal common cancers; 5-year survival ~12%; deadliest by stage-distribution at diagnosis
disease.biology_note: PDAC tumor mass is unusually stromal-dense (often <30% tumor cells; bulk is CAFs, M2 macrophages, MDSCs, regulatory T cells, ECM). Affects every detection pathway: dilutes tumor-cell signals in tissue, enriches stromal-class signals, produces bidirectional immune response that nulls in pooled-entropy.

cookbook_master_readme.reference: See GAPE_EDEAR_Cookbook_v2.1/README_MASTER_v2.1.md for invariant pipeline. Card extends the master invariants with PDAC-specific Stage 1 directional fallback per CCL-027.
cookbook_master_readme.invariants: Xu-538 Stage 1 panel always at H_min(immune)=0.838889; H_min(secretory)=0.843264 used for Stage 2 deconvolved pancreatic_exocrine; Moss NNLS Stage 2; EpiDISH Salas Stage 3; RNG seed 20260425; CCL-027 four-question check fully answered.

specimen_pathways_supported._purpose: Every IDAT input pathway supported for pancreatic-epic. Pipeline is invariant; specimen-specific scoring guidance and confounds differ.

A_plasma_cfdna.specimen: Plasma cfDNA from whole blood (~5 mL EDTA or Streck tube), bisulfite-converted, 450K or 850K array
A_plasma_cfdna.stage_1_role: Xu-538 → H_min(immune); both pooled-entropy AND directional A_dir reported (PDAC requires directional per CCL-027)
A_plasma_cfdna.stage_2_role: Moss NNLS deconvolution → extract pancreatic_exocrine fraction → H_min(secretory) and reference β=0.745
A_plasma_cfdna.stage_3_role: EpiDISH if Stage 1 fires + Stage 2 null
A_plasma_cfdna.deployment_anchor: VAL-046 Rotterdam pre-dx n=182 (cohort-level; per-patient pending)
key_confounds: recent ERCP/stent <30d (direct injury elevates pancreatic shedding)
diabetes (paraneoplastic vs long-standing both shift immune)

B_tissue_biopsy.specimen: FFPE or fresh-frozen pancreatic biopsy ≥100 ng DNA, bisulfite-converted, 450K or 850K array
B_tissue_biopsy.stage_1_role: Xu-538 reads tumor-infiltrating immune compartment, NOT circulating; pooled-entropy null cross-cohort (VAL-066/067/068); use directional fallback
B_tissue_biopsy.stage_2_role: DIRECT read against H_min(secretory) — no deconvolution needed; the biopsy IS the tissue. Highest-fidelity Stage 2 read (no NNLS noise) — represents ceiling magnitude.
B_tissue_biopsy.validated_at: exploratory (3 cohorts; pooled null; directional partial recovery)
B_tissue_biopsy.tumor_cellularity_caveat: PDAC biopsies often <30% tumor cells; document cellularity if available
B_tissue_biopsy.use_when: Pathology lab already has biopsy from EUS-FNA, surgical resection, or post-mortem

C_pancreatic_juice.specimen: Pancreatic juice cells from ERCP, pelleted, DNA extracted, bisulfite-converted, 450K or 850K array
C_pancreatic_juice.stage_1_role: Buffy-coat-trained Xu-538 may not transfer cleanly (juice immune is neutrophil-dominant)
C_pancreatic_juice.stage_2_role: DIRECT read — juice cancer cells are pancreatic-derived
C_pancreatic_juice.use_when: Scheduled ERCP for biliary stenting in suspected PDAC; non-blood non-biopsy alternative

D_urine_cfdna.specimen: Urine sediment cfDNA from spun first-morning void
D_urine_cfdna.stage_1_role: Renal-filtered cfDNA reflects systemic immune; preferential pancreatic shedding into urine NOT documented
D_urine_cfdna.stage_2_role: Limited — pancreatic_exocrine signal in urine cfDNA expected lower than plasma

E_saliva.stage_1_role: Partial — leukocyte fraction overlaps blood; buccal admixture confounds
E_saliva.stage_2_role: Limited — buccal admixture introduces secretory-class background

F_csf.rationale: PDAC does not preferentially shed into CSF. Documented for completeness so future operator does not apply this specimen here.

G_pancreatic_fna.specimen: EUS-guided FNA cytology smear or cell block
G_pancreatic_fna.stage_2_role: DIRECT read — FNA samples ductal lumen content
G_pancreatic_fna.validated_at: exploratory_unvalidated (no PDAC FNA HM450/EPIC cohort in Cookbook)

panel.source: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. JNCI 2020 doi:10.1093/jnci/djz065

scoring_methods_for_PDAC.primary: directional_A_dir (recommended per CCL-027 due to confirmed bidirectional cancellation)
scoring_methods_for_PDAC.secondary: pooled_entropy_A_immune (reported for backward compatibility and as a check)
scoring_methods_for_PDAC.rationale: PDAC drives Xu-538 in genuinely bidirectional fashion — per-CpG positive-direction percentages 46.9%/50.4%/52.9% across VAL-066/067/068. Pooled-entropy null cross-cohort. Directional fallback recovers signal (TCGA-PAAD holdout d=+1.51 p=6.4e-05).

directional_fallback_panel_embedded.score_formula: A_dir = mean over panel of (direction_cpg × z_cpg) where z_cpg = (β − μ_normal_train) / σ_normal_train
directional_fallback_panel_embedded.h_min_independence: z-score normalization makes A_dir mathematically independent of H_min — directional score is class-agnostic by construction

ccl_027_four_questions_answered.i_pooled_direction: Mixed across cohorts, no consensus. VAL-066 paired d=+1.18 (n=5), VAL-067 unpaired d=+0.25 (n=196), VAL-068 paired d=−0.31 (n=7). All CIs span zero on pooled-entropy.
ccl_027_four_questions_answered.ii_bidirectional_risk_with_citation: HIGH. Confirmed in 3 independent tissue cohorts at per-CpG level (positive-direction %: 46.9 / 50.4 / 52.9). Literature predicts: Clark 2007 (PMC1944938) — PDAC drives lymphoid contraction (Tregs up, effector T cells down) + myeloid expansion (MDSCs, M2 macs).
ccl_027_four_questions_answered.iii_directional_fallback: Built and validated. 324-CpG GSE49149-trained subset. TCGA-PAAD holdout d=+1.51 [+0.43,+2.59] p=6.4e-05 PASS. GSE74071 holdout d=+0.22 [−0.53,+0.97] FAIL due to PH64 single-pair outlier. Recommended primary Stage 1 metric for PDAC.
ccl_027_four_questions_answered.iv_lymphoid_myeloid_pattern_literature: Clark 2007: lymphoid down + myeloid up expected. Operational split blocked on Salas IDOL-Ext panel staging — VAL-070 deferred, contributing to OQ-2026-01.

stage_2_localization.moss_atlas_reference: Moss J et al. Nat Commun 2018 DOI 10.1038/s41467-018-07466-6
stage_2_localization.localization_criterion: pancreatic_exocrine ΔA top-1 across 25 deconvolved tissues AND ≥2× second-place tissue ΔA
stage_2_localization.ambiguous_action: If top-1 not 2× top-2, report 'Stage 1 flagged, Stage 2 ambiguous, recommend serial-sample at 6 months.'

saturation_levels._source: GAPE Reproduction Paper Part 2.4A (A_ceiling grid) and Part 2.4B (runtime saturation flag thresholds)
saturation_levels._runtime_flag_rule: Runtime saturation flag fires when sample's A-score on a substrate is within 0.005 of A_ceiling (i.e., A >= A_ceiling - 0.005). Saturated substrates are excluded from A_active aggregation.

nucl.saturation_note: ceiling 1.0177 < 1.10 BREACH threshold; nucl is restricted to NORMAL/MARGINAL/DETECTABLE drift detection only for any secretory-class disease

saturation_levels.v0_1_operational_note: v0.1 deployment runs on 450K/EPIC methylation arrays only. Methyl is the operational substrate at all tiers. The non-methylation substrate guidance applies once the L2/L3 multi-assay platform is operational. Until then, A_ceiling(methyl, secretory) = 1.1859 and runtime flag fires at A >= 1.1809.

NORMAL.notes: All five substrates carry healthy-baseline drift signal

MARGINAL.notes: All five substrates active in this band

DETECTABLE.notes: Nucl A approaches 1.0177 ceiling; weight nucl < 0.5 in A_combined

URGENT.notes: Drop nucl from A_active per runtime flag

FLOOR_BREACH.confirmation_rule: Require >=2 unsaturated substrates above 1.10 for BREACH confirmation; methyl alone above 1.10 is suggestive but not definitive without cross-substrate confirmation

saturation_levels.saturation_clinical_interpretation: When a runtime saturation flag fires for a substrate, that substrate is excluded from A_active aggregation per Reproduction Paper Part 3.3, and the patient EDEAR report carries a saturation alert for that substrate. The flag does NOT indicate disease severity — it indicates measurement-channel exhaustion. A patient with multiple saturated substrates AND elevated unsaturated-substrate A-scores has unambiguous architectural breakdown across multiple physical channels. Saturation on methylation alone in a v0.1 deployment means the methyl channel is exhausted as a progression metric; continued progression must be tracked via Stage 2 pancreatic_exocrine fraction trajectory or, when L2 platform is operational, via fuzz/wps/frag.
saturation_levels.pdac_specific_relevance_of_nucl_saturati: PDAC is the pooled-null-with-directional-recovery disease (mechanism pending OQ-2026-01) (CCL-028). Nucl, which would otherwise serve as an independent cross-check substrate, is structurally saturated for the secretory class and cannot serve that role for PDAC. The cross-check role falls to fuzz, wps, frag once L2/L3 is operational. Until then, the directional fallback panel (VAL-069) is the v0.1 cross-check mechanism — running both pooled methylation A-score AND directional A_dir on the same methylation IDAT provides two independent reads of the same substrate, partially compensating for the nucl loss.

stage_3_subcomposition.method: Teschendorff 2017 EpiDISH RPC mode against Salas 2018 IDOL-Ext reference
stage_3_subcomposition.when_applied: Stage 1 fires AND Stage 2 returns no solid-organ localization
stage_3_subcomposition.literature_predicted_pattern_for_PDAC: Lymphoid arm contraction (effector T cells, B cells) + myeloid arm expansion (MDSCs, M2 macrophages, monocytes). Per Clark 2007.
stage_3_subcomposition.operational_status: Lymphoid/myeloid split on Xu-538 directional panel pending IDOL-Ext panel staging (VAL-070 deferred, OQ-2026-01)

age.rationale: Healthy 80-cell baseline age-decade indexed; PDAC incidence rises after 50

smoking_status.rationale: Largest modifiable PDAC risk factor; shifts immune-class methylation

BMI.rationale: Independent PDAC risk factor; methylation overlap

diabetes_status.rationale: New-onset T2D paraneoplastic; long-standing T2D risk factor; both shift immune

alcohol_intake.rationale: Heavy alcohol → chronic pancreatitis → PDAC pathway

recent_pancreatitis_lt3mo.rationale: Acute pancreatitis transiently elevates pancreatic shedding

recent_ercp_or_stent_lt30d.rationale: Direct injury elevates pancreatic shedding for days-weeks

race_ethnicity.rationale: African American PDAC incidence ~50-90% higher; report for transparency

tier_thresholds_PDAC_specific._calibration_source: TCGA-PAAD holdout per-patient A_dir distribution; tissue-tumor-equivalent magnitudes
tier_thresholds_PDAC_specific._caveat: Tier thresholds tissue-derived; blood deployment will likely require lower thresholds because blood Stage 1 reads attenuated signal vs tumor-tissue immune-infiltrate. Re-calibrate when blood-PDAC cohort available.

clinical_action_matrix.NORMAL_any: Continue baseline cadence (every 1-3 yr depending on age + family history)
clinical_action_matrix.MARGINAL_stage2_null: Serial sample at 6 months; modifiable-risk-factor counseling (smoking, BMI)
clinical_action_matrix.MARGINAL_stage2_ambiguous: Serial sample at 3 months; CA 19-9 + lipase
clinical_action_matrix.DETECTABLE_stage2_null_or_nonpancreatic: Non-PDAC-origin workup: CBC differential, CRP, full Stage 3 EpiDISH; repeat at 3 months
clinical_action_matrix.DETECTABLE_stage2_pancreas_localized: EUS or pancreatic protocol MRI within 4 weeks; gastroenterology consult
clinical_action_matrix.URGENT_any: EUS within 2 weeks; gastroenterology; CA 19-9, lipase, glucose, HbA1c; consider pancreatic protocol CT
clinical_action_matrix.FLOOR_BREACH_any: URGENT actions + oncology consult; family history → genetic counseling (BRCA2/PALB2/ATM panel)
clinical_action_matrix.new_onset_T2D_age_50plus_with_DETECTABLE: Paraneoplastic-PDAC workup REGARDLESS of Stage 2 localization (Pannala 2008)

validation_tier_rationale: Anchored by VAL-046 Rotterdam pre-diagnostic blood n=182 (2-5 yr pre-dx detection at cohort level). Tissue arm validated across 3 cohorts (VAL-066/067/068) showing pooled-entropy null and directional fallback partial recovery (TCGA-PAAD PASS d=+1.51 p<0.001, GSE74071 partial-fail PH64 outlier).

stage_1_anchor_cohort_level.specimen: blood cfDNA, pre-diagnostic (2-5 yr before clinical diagnosis)
stage_1_anchor_cohort_level.limitation: per-patient β not in public domain

tissue_arm_VAL_066_TCGA_PAAD.outcome: O5_UNEXPECTED — pooled positive d=+1.18 but per-CpG split slightly negative (46.9% positive)

tissue_arm_VAL_067_GSE49149.outcome: O3_TISSUE_NULL_LARGE_COHORT — pooled CI straddles zero at largest available cohort; per-CpG split essentially 50/50

tissue_arm_VAL_068_GSE74071.specimen: multi-substrate: 14 tumor + 7 adjacent-normal + 4 juice CCC + 3 CAFs + 1 primary culture, HM450
tissue_arm_VAL_068_GSE74071.outcome: O3_TUMOR_NULL — paired CI straddles zero; PH64 strong negative outlier

directional_fallback_VAL_069.h3_outcome: FAIL (CI straddles zero; PH64 single-pair outlier ΔA_dir=−1.17)

known_limitations: 1. No per-patient pre-diagnostic blood validation (VAL-046 cohort-level only; Rotterdam individual β not public)
2. No 10-year pre-dx data (current cohorts max ~5 yr; longer requires Sister Study or UK Biobank dbGaP)
3. Tissue arm pooled-entropy null across 3 cohorts (CCL-027 bidirectional cancellation signature confirmed)
4. GSE74071 PH64 outlier unresolved (possible mucinous/neuroendocrine sub-type or technical artifact)
5. TCGA-PAAD biased: 5/5 QC-passed male, all white, mostly ductal NOS, mostly Stage IIB
6. Lymphoid/myeloid operational split blocked on Salas IDOL-Ext panel staging (VAL-070 deferred)
7. BMI not populated for any TCGA-PAAD patient in GDC metadata
8. No PDAC blood cfDNA HM450/EPIC cohort tested (GSE150468 was MBD-seq, incompatible with Xu-538)
9. Pancreatic juice substrate Stage 1 unclear (VAL-068 n=4 d=−0.72 exploratory)
10. Tier thresholds tissue-derived; blood deployment will likely need lower thresholds
11. Stage 2 plasma cfDNA Moss NNLS for PDAC not directly validated in this card (relies on framework-wide VAL-041 10-cancer NNLS validation)
next_validation_steps: Priority 1: Acquire individual-patient β from Rotterdam pre-dx cohort (Horvath 2015) for per-patient Stage 1 directional validation
Priority 2: Identify or partner-collect blood-PDAC HM450/EPIC cohort to retrain directional fallback on circulating immune signal (vs tumor-tissue signal)
Priority 3: Stage Salas IDOL-Ext panel and run VAL-070 lymphoid/myeloid operational split on the 324-CpG directional panel
Priority 4: dbGaP application for Sister Study or UK Biobank pancreatic subset for 10-year pre-dx coverage
Priority 5: Resolve GSE74071 PH64 outlier (acquire histology sub-type metadata; search for additional PDAC tissue cohorts with sub-type annotation)
Priority 6: Stage 2 Moss NNLS validation on plasma cfDNA from PDAC patients (paired tumor tissue β as ground truth)

universal_reference._purpose: Self-contained reference block embedded in every EDEAR disease card. Full-inline Option B: do not rely on README_MASTER or any external file for pipeline invariants. A new analyst loading only this card + GAPE_WEB_v13.py must be able to reproduce the full Stage 1 + Stage 2 + Stage 3 pipeline without reading anything else.

universal_stage_1_pipeline.invariant_rule: Every patient's first test is identical regardless of suspected disease: Stage 1 is always immune-class on buffy-coat DNA using the Xu-538 panel with H_min(immune) = 0.838889. This applies to every EDEAR card. What varies per card: expected direction, Stage 2 tissue target, tier thresholds, mandatory covariates, clinical action paths.
universal_stage_1_pipeline.specimen: buffy coat DNA (peripheral blood leukocytes, ~70% immune cells)
universal_stage_1_pipeline.panel_source_paper: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. JNCI 2020;112(1):87-94
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_primary: pooled entropy A-score = mean(H(β)/H_min) across panel
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_secondary_for_bidirection: directional A_dir = mean(direction_i × z_i) when disease drives bidirectional per-CpG drift. Applicable to AD via 7-CpG Rule A panel. Other cards use pooled entropy as primary.

universal_h_min_table._note: Class H_min constants from GAPE_WEB_v13.py lines 87-96. Frozen at G-003b MCMC posterior means, R-hat < 1.001. Used at Stage 2 to compute per-tissue A-scores from deconvolved β values.

universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.method: Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution of the Stage 1 IDAT into 18 per-tissue β values
universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.production_module_status: G-DECONV-001 OPEN-DEFERRED. VAL-041 proved the workflow at published-β level (10/10 top-1 correct localization across 10 cancer types). Production per-IDAT deployment requires: (1) 30 MB Moss 2018 reference matrix locked into the repo; (2) Salas 2018 QC harness implemented; (3) assay version tag (L1 Illumina EPIC + Moss markers, L2 custom capture panel, L3 full 5-substrate MESA+DELFI).

universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.method: Teschendorff 2017 EpiDISH RPC mode, Salas 2018 reference
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.when_applied: Runs when Stage 1 flags AND Stage 2 returns no solid-organ localization. Distinguishes chronic inflammation (neutrophil shift), hematologic immune drift (lymphocyte composition shift), autoimmune patterns, AD-type patterns (brain tissue not in buffy coat).
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.qc_gate_rule: IDATs outside Salas bounds get QC flag; Stage 2 output not released

universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._purpose: Age-decade mean and SD of pooled-entropy immune-class A-score in healthy reference cohorts. Used to compute age-matched percentile for Stage 1 tier calls. Applies to every card's NORMAL / MARGINAL / DETECTABLE tier logic.
_sources: Hannum 2013 Mol Cell (GSE40279 blood methylation aging)
Roadmap Epigenomics Consortium 2015 Nature (127 reference epigenomes)
universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._critical_caveat_cross_cohort: This baseline is derived from the source cohorts using standard preprocessing (primarily minfi/sesame normalization). Cohorts with different preprocessing pipelines (e.g. Ferrari 2014 GSE53740 with ComBat + quantile normalization) can show cohort-level batch offsets of +2 SD or more relative to this baseline. Example: VAL-057 found GSE53740 HC sit at A_age_z = +2.306 vs this baseline. Any card deployment on a non-AIBL/non-AddNeuroMed cohort requires either (a) re-anchoring to within-cohort HC, or (b) a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale. Do not assume universal applicability of these constants across preprocessing pipelines.

universal_tier_thresholds._source: 80-cell healthy baseline reference; same across breast-epic, crc-epic, ad-immune, lung-epic
universal_tier_thresholds._note: Per-card tier thresholds MAY deviate from these universals if disease-specific literature justifies. When they deviate, the card MUST cite the deviation explicitly. Silent deviation is forbidden.

NORMAL.action: No action; serial-sample per screening cadence

URGENT.action: Run Stage 2; expedited workup per disease card

FLOOR_BREACH.action: Run Stage 2; urgent clinical workup regardless of localization

universal_sex_stratification_rule.rule: Every card's deployment MUST stratify reports by sex when sex-differential signal has been documented in validation. At v2.1 this applies to ad-immune (VAL-051: female d=+0.71 vs male d=+0.51 AIBL; VAL-057 male recovery, female non-replication in GSE53740). For other cards, sex stratification is recommended in deployment even where no sex-differential has been documented, since absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
universal_sex_stratification_rule.minimum_reporting: Report must include patient sex. Card scoring MAY differ by sex if documented in validation.

universal_language_discipline.rationale: Every report must present EDEAR output as a flag that changes downstream workup, never as a diagnosis. Final diagnosis requires clinical assessment plus standard-of-care workup (imaging, tissue biopsy, amyloid PET/CSF for AD, etc.) per the relevant clinical guidelines.

universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.description: VAL-057 established that cohort-level preprocessing artifacts can shift pooled-entropy A-score by +2 SD or more relative to the 80-cell Cookbook baseline. This is a systematic offset, not a biological finding. Applies to any new cohort before its baseline can be used for cross-cohort comparison.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.example: GSE53740 (Ferrari 2014, 450K + ComBat + quantile normalization): HC mean A_age_z = +2.306 vs 80-cell immune baseline.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.deployment_rule: (1) On AIBL or AddNeuroMed-equivalent preprocessing: 80-cell baseline usable directly. (2) On any other cohort: re-anchor to within-cohort HC for tier thresholds OR run a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale before applying Cookbook tier thresholds.

universal_no_fabrication_rule.rule: Every numeric value, CpG ID, cohort size, validation result, or citation in this card traces to a primary source or a SHA-locked validation run. Nothing is invented or estimated. If a value is a projection or estimate, it is explicitly labeled as such in its field.

lessons_learned.title: PDAC is the pooled-null-with-directional-recovery disease (mechanism pending OQ-2026-01)
lessons_learned.observation: Per-CpG positive-direction percentages 46.9%, 50.4%, 52.9% across VAL-066/067/068. Pooled-entropy nulls across cohorts.
lessons_learned.implication: Requires directional fallback as primary Stage 1 metric per CCL-027

lessons_learned.title: PDAC tumor cellularity confounds tissue Stage 1
lessons_learned.observation: Biopsies often <30% tumor cells due to dense stromal compartment
lessons_learned.implication: LCM-purified preferred; bulk biopsy mixes tumor + CAFs + immune infiltrate

lessons_learned.title: Pancreatic juice substrate is biologically distinct
lessons_learned.observation: Juice immune is neutrophil-dominant vs blood mixed leukocyte
lessons_learned.implication: Buffy-coat-trained Xu-538 may not transfer cleanly; juice pathway needs dedicated calibration

lessons_learned.title: Public-domain matched-pair PDAC methylation cohorts are scarce
lessons_learned.observation: TCGA-PAAD HM450 matched n=10 candidates → n=7 amended → n=5 effective
lessons_learned.implication: Future cards manifest-verify before assuming TCGA matched-pair availability

lessons_learned.title: GSE49149 is the natural training set for PDAC directional panels
lessons_learned.observation: n=196 (167+29) HM450 — largest publicly accessible PDAC tissue cohort
lessons_learned.implication: PDAC directional refinements train on GSE49149, validate on TCGA-PAAD + GSE74071 holdouts

lessons_learned.title: New-onset T2D ≥50 yr is the strongest clinical risk-stratifier
lessons_learned.observation: Pannala 2008: new-onset T2D in this age group + immune drift = ~1% pre-test PDAC probability
lessons_learned.implication: Action matrix deviates from universal default — paraneoplastic workup REGARDLESS of Stage 2 localization for new-onset T2D + DETECTABLE-or-above

lessons_learned.title: Stage 1 ALWAYS scores Xu-538 against H_min(immune) regardless of disease
lessons_learned.observation: Earlier draft of VAL-066/067/068/069 used H_min(secretory) in error. Cohen's d unchanged (scale-invariant) but absolute A-scores were 0.5% off and cross-card numerical comparability broke.
lessons_learned.implication: Panel-class governs H_min in Stage 1; tissue-class is a Stage 2 concept only. Universal pipeline rule. Future card authors verify H_min(immune)=0.838889 in their Stage 1 scripts before publishing.
